checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Lit candle in amber jar fills the center of the frame.
Jar, lid and slab edges are crisp. The label text is garbled but shapes are fine.
Only eucalyptus, stones, lid and stand, all as requested.

must.item: Controlled lighting, coordinated background, polished retail look
must.why: Warm beige palette, soft light, blurred background, travertine stand.

faults.what: Label text is pseudo-text: the brand reads 'DucAlera' and the small line beneath is illegible gibberish. The user asked for a plain label with gold lettering, so invented text is an AI artefact.
The lid leans on the jar and a stone and looks slightly oddly placed. The jar rim looks a bit flat.

summary: A premium-looking lit amber candle on a travertine slab with a black lid, eucalyptus and stones came out well, with only gibberish label text and low resolution as flaws.
